QuestInfo.name: [Chu Chu] Goodbye, Chu Chu Island
QuestInfo.0: Muto loved the sandwich you worked so hard to make. Oh, and Chu Chu Island is safe from Gulla. Now it's time for you to continue your journey to the Black Mage.
QuestInfo.1: Muto loved the sandwich you worked so hard to make. Oh, and Chu Chu Island is safe from Gulla. Now it's time for you to continue your journey to the Black Mage.
QuestInfo.2:
Maybe it was Simia's kind heart that moved Muto and not her excellent cooking skills. In any event, Master Lyck acknowledged Simia's skill as a chef, even though he doesn't agree with her sense of taste. He declared Simia the personal chef of Muto from this day forward. All's well that ends well... so, on to the Black Mage!

Goodbye, Chu Chu Island!
